purpose: Replace whole-identity burn-down and random pool expansion with a deterministic exposure-aware development resource model that represents time and listing-board structure before any successor result-bearing Stage experiment.

board_axis.authority: dwd_listing.board_code at the declared point in time

time_axis.principle: Use calendar/rule-defined regimes, not bull/bear labels inferred from later returns.
time_axis.regime_boundary_basis: listing-board availability and versioned trading-rule boundaries, not ex-post market performance
time_axis.calendar_subwindows: capacity census must report non-overlapping usable windows within each era before quotas are frozen

sector_axis.reason: Current DWD industry membership is not authoritative historical PIT truth across the full development horizon; static industry mapping is concentration-only and cannot be promoted into historical sector truth.
sector_axis.allowed_now: diagnostic metadata only when the classification is authoritative at the sampled time
sector_axis.future_upgrade: A separately governed PIT historical sector membership source may add a sector axis without changing the board axis.

required_outputs: unique economic identities by era x board family
non-overlapping usable windows by era x board family
counts released by replacing whole-identity exclusion with disjoint-window development reuse
capacity after preserving L5 identity-global exclusion
capacity_census_next.quota_freeze_rule: Exact board-era quotas must be frozen after metadata-only census and before any result-bearing market read; quotas may not be changed after outcome evidence.
allocation_principles: cover every structurally present board-era cell before adding density to already represented cells
prevent MAIN from consuming the sample merely because it is the largest family
allocate additional capacity deterministically from metadata-only cell capacity, not randomly
preserve one-case-per-economic-identity inside each scored review slice unless a later preregistration explicitly changes that rule
report repeated-identity-across-disjoint-windows separately and never count it as identity-independent evidence

explicit_non_goals: Do not reopen or rerun P012 G1.
Do not lower P012 gates or reinterpret its failed receipt as success.
Do not use 2024 technology-bull knowledge as a retrospective sample-selection label.
Do not treat current/static industry membership as historical sector truth.
Do not open 2021, 2022-2024 or 2025 market-result surfaces in the capacity census.
Do not retune P008 relocation or add Stage candidates in this resource-design step.
claim_ceiling: This design selects how future development resources are counted and stratified. It does not prove sample sufficiency, authorize a result-bearing Stage experiment, qualify any atomic proposition, or make a market-regime performance claim.
